headline: A 2015 law renames a St. Louis, Missouri Postal Service facility the "Sgt. Amanda N. Pinson Post Office."
what_it_does: This law officially names the Postal Service facility at 55 Grasso Plaza in St. Louis, Missouri, after Sgt. Amanda N. Pinson. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 5, 2015.
